entities.summary: Baba Mardoukh Rouhani was an Islamic academic. He was born in 1923 in the village of Kashtar, Sanandaj, Kurdistan province, Iran. He received his early education from his father, Sheykh Habeeb Ollah Modarrisi, later moving to Sanandaj, where he was instructed by several Islamic sciences professors. Baba Mardoukh's notable works were in the fields of fiqh, tafsir, logic, and mathematics. One of his works, The History of Notable Kurds is widely regarded to be his best, which he wrote in Persian. After finishing his studies in Islamic sciences in Kurdistan, he moved to Tehran, where he enrolled in Tehran University, where he met some prominent Persian professors like Badiozzaman Forouzanfar.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Baba Mardoukh Rohanee's work on Islamic sciences and his notable book 'The History of Notable Kurds' contributed to the preservation of Kurdish culture and identity. His writings had a significant impact on the education and intellectual development of Kurds in Iran.
